Subject: GCP PM orchestration: account queue & priority routing

Team —

I pulled the Q2 co-sell queue and attached a starter triage (gcp_co-sell_queue_q2.xlsx). Goal: pick the 6 highest-probability GCP co-sell targets for this two-week sprint, align owners, and surface any listing blockers that would prevent a Marketplace listing push. High-level asks: 

- Vanessa: name a field owner for each account (who will lead commercial/co-sell) and confirm next week availability for handshake with GCP PM.
- Karthik: flag any accounts that lack listing readiness items (SKU mapping, billing contact, security evidence) and estimate time to completion.
- Ben: mark any deals where we should prioritize Dedicated capacity offers vs hosted API for the co-sell pitch.

I flagged Acme Health as priority (see row 4) — Sara (Acme) is already engaged; we should confirm a joint technical sync and align on timeline for listing artifacts.

Attached: gcp_co-sell_queue_q2.xlsx (sheet: prioritized_queue)
Also: quick-read playbook attached for triage criteria (redwood_gcp_listing_playbook_v2.pdf).

Next step: Vanessa to share owners by EOD Monday; Karthik to return readiness checklist by Tuesday.

Thanks —
Marissa

- I assigned Acme Health to me (Sara looped in) — propose we schedule a joint kickoff with GCP PM this week (aiming Wed 5/19, morning PT).
- Quantum Health looks ready commercially but needs the security questionnaire completed before listing — I've asked CS to pull evidence.
- NovaHealth and Meridian both prefer a demo-centric co-sell (we should offer a dedicated capacity pilot).

Action items for this thread: 
1) I'll book the Acme kickoff and include the initial MAP (mutual action plan) draft.
2) Sara — can you confirm Wed morning PT or suggest alternatives?
3) Karthik — please call out specific evidence gaps (SOC 2 artifacts, retention policies, billing contact) inline on the sheet.

Thanks — I reviewed the sheet and added an internal readiness column with short timelines. Summary of blockers: 

- Acme Health: missing SKU mapping and billing contact; security docs mostly OK but need a signed DPA (I put a note with the legal queue). ETA: SKU mapping + billing contact = 3 business days if Sara confirms the billing owner; DPA depends on legal but we can start listing work in parallel.
- Quantum Health: SOC 2 excerpts are missing from the evidence package; CS can surface within 5 days.
- NovaHealth: requires quantization/latency SLA conversation — recommend we offer a 30-day Dedicated pilot.

I also uploaded a short checklist (see playbook link) and a DocuSign listing agreement draft link in the HubSpot deal (linked below). If GCP PM confirms co-sell handshake, we should ask GCP to register the opportunity in their pipeline (so it counts toward quotas).
